newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow Telecom 96 dividend set to double.
newsitem.headline: Moscow Telecom 96 dividend set to double.

text.p: Russia's MGTS Moscow telephone network company expects a dividend of between 105,000 and 108,000 roubles on its preference shares for 1996, up from 51,805 roubles for 1995, a company official said on Monday.

"The dividend on preference shares will not be below 100,000 roubles, approximately 105,000-108,000 roubles," Boris Lastovich, head of securities at MGTS (Moskovskaya Gorodskaya Telfonnaya Set) told Reuters.
Preference shares have a face value of 1,000 roubles.
Lastovich said dividend on ordinary stock had not yet been set, but added that the company planned to spend about two percent of its profit, the same as last year, on the dividend.
He did not say what 1996 profit was.
Dividend on ordinary shares was 3,450 roubles per 1,000-rouble share in 1995.
